other_apps.staryl_description: Staryl brings Twitch live and offline notifications into Discord.
other_apps.title: Two apps, one project.
other_apps.wolfstar_description: WolfStar combines configurable moderation, server event logging, and dashboard-managed settings.

commands.description: Use Staryl’s Twitch subscription commands to send live and offline stream notifications to the right channel.
commands.title: Configure Twitch notifications with Staryl.

cta.subtitle: Invite Staryl now, or join the support server if you want to ask a question first.
cta.title: Bring your streamers into your server.

features.description: A live alert with the stream's title, game and preview, an offline note in your own words, and a test whenever you want to check the channel.
features.live_body: The stream's title links to the channel, next to the game and its box art, above a preview of the stream and a button to watch.
features.notifications_description: Each subscription sends one streamer's live or offline update to one channel. Pick a kind to see what lands there.
features.offline_body: An offline subscription posts the message you wrote for it, with the time the stream ended. Offline subscriptions need that message.
features.offline_message: Stella's stream is over, thanks for watching!
features.ping_body: Give the subscription a message and it goes above the notification. Mention a role in it and Staryl pings that role, as long as the role can be mentioned.
features.test_body: A test goes through the same path as a real notification, so a missing permission shows up now and not at the next stream. It says it is a test.
features.test_notice: this is a preview requested by a server administrator, not a real stream update.
features.title: One message per stream, in your channel.

hero.routing_value: One streamer, one channel, one alert type per subscription
hero.sources_value: Twitch live and offline alerts today, more sources planned
hero.subtitle: Staryl posts a message in the channel you choose when a Twitch streamer goes live or offline. Set it up with one command.
hero.title: Social updates, where your server already is.

notification.message: Stella is live, come say hi!
notification.preview_alt: The stream's preview: a code editor and the streamer's webcam.

proof.step_1_body: Choose the streamer. Twitch is the only source today, and more sources are planned.
proof.step_2_body: Each subscription sends one streamer's live or offline notification to one channel.
proof.step_3_body: A server team adds, removes, shows, resets, and tests subscriptions with Staryl's slash commands. No dashboard is needed.

seo.description: WolfStar gives Discord moderation teams configurable AutoMod, searchable moderation and command history, and one dashboard for server settings.
seo.title: Home

showcase.action_alert_body: send a message notifying the user of their infraction.
showcase.action_delete_body: delete the message that triggered the infraction, keeping your channels clean.
showcase.action_log_body: send a message to the moderation log channel for moderators to see.
showcase.automod_attachments_alert: file attachments aren't allowed in this channel.
showcase.automod_capitals_alert: please reduce your use of capital letters.
showcase.automod_intro: Choose which messages trigger a rule, then decide how WolfStar responds.
showcase.automod_invites_alert: invite links aren't allowed in this channel.
showcase.automod_links_alert: you sent links that aren't allowed here.
showcase.automod_newlines_alert: your message contains too many lines.
showcase.automod_reactions_alert: you cannot react with that emoji.
showcase.automod_spam_alert: please refrain from reposting the same message multiple times.
showcase.automod_words_alert: you said something that is not allowed in this server.
showcase.escalation_action_body: warn, timeout, kick, or ban, with a temporary or permanent duration where supported.
showcase.escalation_intro: Repeated infractions can trigger a separate escalation rule:
showcase.escalation_threshold_body: choose how many infractions within a time window trigger the action.
showcase.feature_automod_description: Move through real filter examples and see the message, response, and escalation controls together.
showcase.feature_automod_title: Configure the rule before it fires
showcase.feature_logging_description: Choose which server events reach Discord, then search moderation, command, and settings history in the dashboard.
showcase.feature_logging_title: Keep live events and reviewable history
showcase.feature_moderation_description: Every moderation action keeps the details your team needs to review it.
showcase.header_description: Use the controls to inspect the same moderation flow your team configures and reviews.
showcase.header_title: Follow a rule from trigger to review.
showcase.logging_intro: Send member, channel, role, message, and moderation events to the Discord channels your team already watches.
showcase.logging_item_filter: Filter moderation history by member, moderator, action, date, or search text.
showcase.logging_item_views: Keep command outcomes and dashboard settings activity in their own reviewable views.
showcase.mod_copy_audit: WolfStar can also record supported moderation actions performed directly in Discord, including their audit-log reason.
showcase.mod_copy_search: Search moderation history by member, moderator, action, date, or text. Each entry keeps the action and reason together.
